summary: The registrant, T. Rowe Price OHA Select Private Credit Fund, filed an 8-K disclosing a regular monthly distribution declaration, net asset value as of May 31, 2026, status of a continuous public offering, and share repurchase results. The distribution is a routine periodic payout; no event or structural change constitutes a special situation. The share repurchase was a standard issuer tender of up to 5% of shares under a periodic program, not a material corporate event. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, going-private, spin-off, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or other special-situation element is present. The filing is a routine current report with ordinary operational updates.
